manifest.name: FitMetZorge
manifest.description: Je training, voeding en begeleiding bij FitMetZorge.

scope: All commit-tracked root runtime documents/scripts/styles/images, assets/**, vendor/**, tutorial/** and output/**. Git blobs, never modified working files. Unknown arbitrary server paths cannot be enumerated from HTTP.

migrationComparison.method: Supabase list_migrations read-only API compared with exact Git tree

limits: Read-only evidence; no restore tag or branch created by this script.
This verifies public artifacts and migration identities, not an exact dump or restoration of private production data.
Existing production activity may continue; no customer records, invoices, Storage objects or Auth sessions were modified.
Pages configuration authorization failures are retained explicitly; they are not a successful configuration read.

hostingAuthenticatedRead.method: Existing Git credential helper held in process memory; GET only; no credential serialized
